title: BrowsePage: spec heading text and "Available" / "On loan"
goal: Make the catalogue's heading and each book's availability match the spec wording. (Paging is a separate task: keep listing every book.)
spec: BRW-1: The page at `/` has the main heading "Library catalogue" and shows the books six at a time, each with its title, its author, its genre, its year and "Available" or "On loan"; each title is a link to the book's page at `/books/<id>`.
